patterns.name: causal_context
patterns.description: Direct evidence paths from the decision's factors to the predicted outcome (causal explanations), up to $limit facts per factor.
patterns.cypher:
MATCH (f)-[r:INCREASES_RISK_OF]->(o:ClinicalOutcome {_key: $outcome})
WHERE f._key IN $factors
WITH f, o, r ORDER BY r._prov_confidence DESC, r._prov_fact_id
WITH f, o, collect(r)[..$limit] AS rs
UNWIND rs AS r
RETURN labels(f)[0] AS factorType, f.name AS factor, f._key AS factorKey, f._plain_label AS factorLabel,
       type(r) AS relation, o.name AS outcome,
       r._prov_fact_id AS factId, r._prov_source_document AS sourceDocument, r._prov_char_start AS charStart,
       r._prov_char_end AS charEnd, r._prov_confidence AS confidence, r._prov_prompt_id AS promptId
ORDER BY confidence DESC, factId

patterns.name: drug_adverse_chain
patterns.description: Two-hop evidence: a drug the patient takes may cause a condition that increases the risk of the outcome (up to $limit chains per drug).
patterns.cypher:
MATCH (d:Drug)-[r1:MAY_CAUSE]->(c:Condition)-[r2:INCREASES_RISK_OF]->(o:ClinicalOutcome {_key: $outcome})
WHERE d._key IN $factors
WITH d, c, o, r1, r2 ORDER BY r1._prov_confidence * r2._prov_confidence DESC, r1._prov_fact_id, r2._prov_fact_id
WITH d, collect({condition: c.name, outcome: o.name,
                 factId1: r1._prov_fact_id, source1: r1._prov_source_document, confidence1: r1._prov_confidence,
                 factId2: r2._prov_fact_id, source2: r2._prov_source_document, confidence2: r2._prov_confidence})[..$limit] AS chains
UNWIND chains AS x
RETURN d.name AS drug, d._key AS factorKey, x.condition AS condition, x.outcome AS outcome,
       x.factId1 AS factId1, x.source1 AS source1, x.confidence1 AS confidence1,
       x.factId2 AS factId2, x.source2 AS source2, x.confidence2 AS confidence2
ORDER BY confidence1 * confidence2 DESC, factId1, factId2

patterns.name: lab_indication_chain
patterns.description: Two-hop evidence: an abnormal lab level indicates a condition that increases the risk of the outcome (up to $limit chains per lab level).
patterns.cypher:
MATCH (l:LabTest)-[r1:INDICATES]->(c:Condition)-[r2:INCREASES_RISK_OF]->(o:ClinicalOutcome {_key: $outcome})
WHERE l._key IN $factors
WITH l, c, o, r1, r2 ORDER BY r1._prov_confidence * r2._prov_confidence DESC, r1._prov_fact_id, r2._prov_fact_id
WITH l, collect({condition: c.name, outcome: o.name,
                 factId1: r1._prov_fact_id, source1: r1._prov_source_document, confidence1: r1._prov_confidence,
                 factId2: r2._prov_fact_id, source2: r2._prov_source_document, confidence2: r2._prov_confidence})[..$limit] AS chains
UNWIND chains AS x
RETURN l.name AS labTest, l._key AS factorKey, x.condition AS condition, x.outcome AS outcome,
       x.factId1 AS factId1, x.source1 AS source1, x.confidence1 AS confidence1,
       x.factId2 AS factId2, x.source2 AS source2, x.confidence2 AS confidence2
ORDER BY confidence1 * confidence2 DESC, factId1, factId2

patterns.name: contrastive_difference
patterns.description: Evidence for the factors present in this decision but absent in the contrast case (why this patient and not a similar one), up to $limit facts per factor.
patterns.cypher:
UNWIND [x IN $factors WHERE NOT x IN $contrastFactors] AS differing
MATCH (f {_key: differing})-[r:INCREASES_RISK_OF]->(o:ClinicalOutcome {_key: $outcome})
WITH f, o, r ORDER BY r._prov_confidence DESC, r._prov_fact_id
WITH f, o, collect(r)[..$limit] AS rs
UNWIND rs AS r
RETURN labels(f)[0] AS factorType, f.name AS factor, f._key AS factorKey, f._plain_label AS factorLabel, o.name AS outcome,
       r._prov_fact_id AS factId, r._prov_source_document AS sourceDocument, r._prov_confidence AS confidence
ORDER BY confidence DESC, factId

patterns.name: counterfactual_recommendations
patterns.description: Guideline recommendations of a modifiable medicine or care process for a condition of the encounter on the path to the outcome: the condition is active itself or indicated by an active lab level, and it or the active entity increases the risk of the outcome (what could change the outcome). Recommendations of the different conditions are interleaved, up to $limit per condition.
patterns.cypher:
MATCH (f)
WHERE f._key IN $active
MATCH (rec:Recommendation)-[ra:APPLIES_TO]->(c:Condition)
WHERE (c = f OR (f)-[:INDICATES]->(c))
  AND (EXISTS { MATCH (f)-[:INCREASES_RISK_OF]->(:ClinicalOutcome {_key: $outcome}) }
       OR EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:INCREASES_RISK_OF]->(:ClinicalOutcome {_key: $outcome}) })
MATCH (rec)-[rr:RECOMMENDS]->(t)
WHERE t._modifiable = true
WITH rec, ra, c, collect(DISTINCT f.name) AS via, collect(DISTINCT t.name) AS recommends,
     collect(DISTINCT coalesce(t._plain_label, t.name)) AS recommendsLabel, collect(DISTINCT t._key) AS actionKeys,
     collect(DISTINCT rr._prov_fact_id) AS factIdsRecommends
ORDER BY ra._prov_confidence DESC, ra._prov_fact_id
WITH c, collect({recommendation: rec.statement, guidelineSource: rec.source, strength: rec.strength, via: via,
                 recommends: recommends, recommendsLabel: recommendsLabel, actionKeys: actionKeys,
                 factId: ra._prov_fact_id, factIdsRecommends: factIdsRecommends,
                 sourceDocument: ra._prov_source_document, confidence: ra._prov_confidence})[..$limit] AS advice
UNWIND range(0, size(advice) - 1) AS conditionRank
WITH c, advice[conditionRank] AS x, conditionRank
RETURN x.recommendation AS recommendation, x.guidelineSource AS guidelineSource, x.strength AS strength,
       c.name AS condition, c._plain_label AS conditionLabel, x.via AS via, x.recommends AS recommends,
       x.recommendsLabel AS recommendsLabel, x.actionKeys AS actionKeys, x.factId AS factId,
       x.factIdsRecommends AS factIdsRecommends, x.sourceDocument AS sourceDocument, x.confidence AS confidence,
       conditionRank
ORDER BY conditionRank, confidence DESC, condition, factId

patterns.name: protective_factors
patterns.description: Modifiable factors and drugs the literature associates with a lower probability of the outcome, excluding drugs contraindicated in a condition of the encounter, ranked first by their relation to the encounter's active entities (the entity itself is active, it treats or interacts with an active entity, or its evidence studies the active entities) (counterfactual explanations: what lowers the risk).
patterns.cypher:
MATCH (f)-[r:REDUCES_RISK_OF]->(o:ClinicalOutcome {_key: $outcome})
WHERE f._modifiable = true
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (f)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN]->(x) WHERE x._key IN $active }
WITH f, o, collect(r) AS rs
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:TREATS|INTERACTS_WITH]-(a)
WHERE a._key IN $active
WITH f, o, rs, collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS linked
OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:EXTRACTED_FROM]->(d:SourceDocument)
WHERE m._key IN $active AND NOT m = f AND d.id IN [x IN rs | x._prov_source_document]
WITH f, o, rs, linked, collect(DISTINCT m.name) AS studied
WITH f, o, rs, reduce(acc = CASE WHEN f._key IN $active THEN [f.name] ELSE [] END, x IN linked + studied |
       CASE WHEN x IN acc THEN acc ELSE acc + x END) AS relatedTo
WITH f, o, rs, relatedTo,
     reduce(b = head(rs), x IN rs | CASE WHEN x._prov_confidence > b._prov_confidence THEN x ELSE b END) AS best
RETURN labels(f)[0] AS factorType, f.name AS protectiveFactor, f._plain_label AS protectiveLabel, [f._key] AS actionKeys,
       o.name AS outcome, relatedTo, size(relatedTo) AS relevance, size(rs) AS sources,
       best._prov_fact_id AS factId, [x IN rs | x._prov_fact_id] AS factIds,
       best._prov_source_document AS sourceDocument, best._prov_confidence AS confidence
ORDER BY relevance DESC, sources DESC, confidence DESC, protectiveFactor
LIMIT $limit

patterns.name: guideline_rules
patterns.description: All guideline statements applying to the conditions active for the encounter (rule-based explanations, compliance view). Statements of the different conditions are interleaved, up to $limit per condition.
patterns.cypher:
MATCH (rec:Recommendation)-[ra:APPLIES_TO]->(c:Condition)
WHERE c._key IN $active
OPTIONAL MATCH (rec)-[:RECOMMENDS]->(target)
WITH rec, ra, c, collect(DISTINCT target.name) AS recommends
ORDER BY ra._prov_confidence DESC, ra._prov_fact_id
WITH c, collect({recommendation: rec.statement, guidelineSource: rec.source, strength: rec.strength,
                 recommends: recommends, factId: ra._prov_fact_id, sourceDocument: ra._prov_source_document,
                 confidence: ra._prov_confidence})[..$limit] AS statements
UNWIND range(0, size(statements) - 1) AS conditionRank
WITH c, statements[conditionRank] AS x, conditionRank
RETURN x.recommendation AS recommendation, x.guidelineSource AS guidelineSource, x.strength AS strength,
       c.name AS condition, x.recommends AS recommends,
       x.factId AS factId, x.sourceDocument AS sourceDocument, x.confidence AS confidence, conditionRank
ORDER BY conditionRank, confidence DESC, condition, factId

patterns.name: provenance_trace
patterns.description: Full provenance of given facts: source document, character span, extraction run (prompt version, LLM), validation policy version.
patterns.cypher:
MATCH (s)-[r]->(t)
WHERE r._prov_fact_id IN $factIds
OPTIONAL MATCH (doc:SourceDocument {id: r._prov_source_document})
OPTIONAL MATCH (run:ExtractionRun {runId: r._prov_run_id})
RETURN r._prov_fact_id AS factId, labels(s)[0] AS sourceType, coalesce(s.name, s.statement) AS source, type(r) AS relation,
       labels(t)[0] AS targetType, coalesce(t.name, t.statement) AS target,
       properties(r) AS provenance, properties(doc) AS document, properties(run) AS extractionRun
